about_the_game:
Are you ready to find 500 adorable cats lost in the atmosphere of a Renaissance art gallery? Explore 5 unique maps filled with classical paintings, sculptures, and period details. Discover cats hiding in these hand-drawn scenes and color each one by numbers to bring this historic art gallery to life!

Each map offers a rich Renaissance aesthetic with hand-drawn details. Can you find the cats hidden in this art-filled world?

🎨 After finding them, color each scene only by numbers. Experience this art gallery with the relaxing power of colors and historic atmosphere!

✨ Features:

🖼️ 5 unique Renaissance gallery maps

🐱 500 hidden cats in total

🎨 Paint-by-numbers system

🧘‍♀️ Relaxed gameplay without time pressure

🎧 Special themed Renaissance radio broadcast

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play online duo with a friend
